verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships a built-in web UI served by `llama serve` and an interactive `llama cli` chat, including vision sessions, so users can hand prompts to a local model. Community users describe delegating real work this way, such as generating photo descriptions, keywords and OCR. The evidence shows a chat interface for a model the user loads, not an agentic assistant that executes delegated tasks. missing for 10: evidence of agentic task execution (tool use, multi-step actions) in the built-in UI, documentation describing the web UI's assistant capabilities in depth.
